title: 第七章 权臣侧目，姨娘心忧
content_zh:
萧聿辞步履从容，玄色锦袍上暗绣的金线蟒纹在日光下泛着冷润光泽，随行护卫立在园门两侧，一身肃杀之气压得府里仆婢齐齐垂首，连方才哭闹不休的沈轻柔都下意识收了哭声，怯怯躲在柳氏身侧，眼底藏着不易察觉的慌乱。

丞相沈敬山见状连忙上前拱手行礼，面上带着几分窘迫：“不知王爷骤然到访，府中琐事惊扰殿下，实在失礼。”

萧聿辞淡淡抬手免了礼数，狭长的凤目未曾落在上前逢迎的柳氏与沈轻柔身上，视线仍旧落于不远处的沈清鸢。少女一身湖蓝罗裙立在海棠花树下，发丝被微风拂动几缕，明明方才刚戳破庶妹下药的诡计，此刻眉眼平静无波，半点没有寻常闺阁女子被闹剧牵连的局促慌乱，反倒透着一股与十五岁年纪不符的沉静城府。

“丞相客气，本王顺路赴约，恰巧路过罢了。”他嗓音低沉冷冽，语气听不出喜怒，话锋却轻轻一转，“方才园内喧哗，可是出了什么事端？”

柳氏心头猛地一紧，生怕沈清鸢当众把下药之事捅破，抢先一步上前，堆着温婉笑意回话：“回王爷，不过是小女身子不适，一时失了分寸闹了小别扭，劳王爷挂心。”她说着暗暗用眼角余光去剜沈清鸢，暗含警告，想逼着沈清鸢顺着自己的话把事情糊弄过去。

沈清鸢只垂眸捻了捻袖口绣着的兰草纹样，没有接话。她清楚柳氏打的算盘，眼下老夫人在场，贸然撕破脸反倒落得她不懂尊卑、苛待庶妹的口舌，不如静观其变，看柳氏还能如何圆谎。

老夫人拄着檀木拐杖缓缓起身，目光扫过柳氏一闪而过的慌张神色，心里早已把内里弯弯绕绕看得分明，面上却依旧和蔼，笑着对萧聿辞道：“一点后宅鸡毛小事，劳殿下费心，不如移步正厅饮茶歇息。”

萧聿辞眸光微动，视线再次掠过沈清鸢，淡淡颔首应下：“老夫人盛情，本王叨扰了。”

一行人往正厅走去，路过沈清鸢身侧时，萧聿辞脚步微顿，旁人只当他无意驻足，唯有沈清鸢敏锐察觉到一道沉沉目光落在自己身上，抬眼恰好撞进他深邃的眼眸里。那双素来浸满寒意的眸子藏着几分探究，似是看穿了她伪装温顺下的满腹算计，她心头微凛，不动声色屈膝福身避让。

待众人尽数入厅，留在园中的柳氏立马拉着沈轻柔躲去偏廊，脸上的温柔尽数褪去，压低声音怒斥：“成事不足败事有余！方才险些被沈清鸢拆穿，偏偏赶上摄政王登门，若是露出半点破绽，咱们母女往后在相府再无立足之地！”

沈轻柔眼眶通红，攥着衣角满心不甘：“娘亲，明明药都下好了，不知沈清鸢从哪提前得知，反倒摆了我们一道，还有方才摄政王看她的眼神，分明不一样，难不成他看上沈清鸢了？”

柳氏眉头紧锁，心底莫名生出忌惮。摄政王权倾朝野，连陛下都要让上三分，若是萧聿辞真有心护着沈清鸢，往后她们想要算计嫡女、夺下管家权，更是难如登天。她沉吟片刻，眼底闪过阴翳：“无妨，来日方长，咱们还有太子那条路，先稳住，慢慢寻别的法子收拾她。”

另一边正厅内，茶水刚奉上来，萧聿辞看似随口闲谈，状似无意向沈敬山问询：“听闻丞相嫡女聪慧过人，方才园中所见，果然气度不凡。”

沈敬山愣了愣，自打从前沈清鸢痴恋太子、事事偏帮沈轻柔，他素来觉得嫡女天真愚钝，今日接连几件事，早已改观不少，闻言顺势笑道：“小女近来心性大变，懂事不少。”

萧聿辞指尖轻叩桌面，眸底藏起一丝浅淡笑意，原来重生归来的沈清鸢，当真和前世那个任人摆布、惨死火场的傻姑娘，判若两人。
content_en:
Xiao Yuci walked calmly, and the golden python pattern embroidered on the black brocade robe glowed coldly in the sunlight. The accompanying guards stood on both sides of the garden gate. Their aura of solemnity made all the servants in the house hang their heads. Even Shen Qingrou, who had been crying endlessly, subconsciously stopped crying and hid timidly beside Liu, with an imperceptible panic hidden in her eyes.

Upon seeing this, Prime Minister Shen Jingshan hurriedly stepped forward to salute, with a bit of embarrassment on his face: "I don't know that the prince has suddenly arrived. It is really rude to disturb His Highness with trivial matters in the palace."

Xiao Yuci raised his hand indifferently to avoid being polite. His long and narrow eyes never fell on Liu and Shen Qingrou who stepped forward to greet them, but his eyes still fell on Shen Qingyuan not far away.The girl was standing under the crabapple tree in a lake-blue skirt. A few strands of her hair were ruffled by the breeze. It was clear that she had just exposed the concubine's drugged plot. Her face and eyes were calm at the moment. She was not at all embarrassed and panicked by an ordinary girl in a boudoir being implicated in a farce. Instead, she exuded a calmness that was inconsistent with her fifteen-year-old age.

"Prime Minister, you are welcome. I am on my way to an appointment. I just happened to pass by." His voice was low and cold, and there was no emotion or anger in his tone, but he changed the topic slightly, "There was a lot of noise in the garden just now, but what happened?"

Mrs. Liu's heart suddenly tightened, fearing that Shen Qingyuan would reveal the drugging in public, so she stepped forward first and replied with a gentle smile: "My lord, it's just that the little girl is not feeling well for a moment.I lost my sense and caused a little commotion, Prince Lao is worried." She said, secretly poking out Shen Qingyuan with the corner of her eye, implying a warning, trying to force Shen Qingyuan to follow her words and get over the matter.

Shen Qingyuan only lowered his eyes and twisted the orchid grass pattern embroidered on his sleeves, but did not answer.She knew Mrs. Liu's plan. Now that the old lady was present, she would rashly break up with her, which would lead to her not understanding dignity and treating her concubine harshly. It would be better to wait and see what happens, and see how Liu could still make up her lies.

The old lady stood up slowly while leaning on the sandalwood crutches. Her eyes glanced at Mr. Liu's fleeting panic expression. She had already clearly seen the twists and turns inside, but her face was still kind. She smiled and said to Xiao Yu: "I have troubled Your Highness with a little trivial matter in the back house. Why don't you go to the main hall to drink tea and rest."

Xiao Yuci's eyes moved slightly, his gaze passed over Shen Qingyuan again, and he nodded lightly in response: "Old Madam, I'm so kind, I'm sorry to bother you."

The group of people walked towards the main hall. When passing by Shen Qingyuan, Xiao Yuci paused slightly. Others thought he had stopped unintentionally. Only Shen Qingyuan was keenly aware of a heavy gaze falling on him, and raised his eyes just in time to catch his deep eyes.Those eyes that were always filled with coldness concealed a bit of inquiry, as if they had seen through the calculations behind her disguise of meekness. Her heart was slightly shuddered, and she calmly knelt down to avoid him.

After everyone entered the hall, Mrs. Liu, who was staying in the garden, immediately pulled Shen Qingrou and hid in the side corridor. The tenderness on her face faded away, and she shouted angrily in a low voice: "If you succeed, you will fail! Just now, Shen Qingyuan almost exposed you, but the regent came to visit. If there is any flaw, we, mother and daughter, will no longer have a foothold in the Prime Minister's Mansion!"

Shen Qingrou's eyes were red, and she clutched the corners of her clothes with dissatisfaction: "Mother, the medicine has been given, but I don't know where Shen Qingyuan knew it in advance, but instead he tricked us. The way the Regent looked at her just now was clearly different. Could it be that he has fallen in love with Shen Qingyuan?"

Madam Liu frowned, feeling inexplicably fearful in her heart.The power of the regent was overwhelming, and even His Majesty had to give up three points. If Xiao Yuci really wanted to protect Shen Qingyuan, it would be even more difficult for them to plot against their legitimate daughter and seize the power of the housekeeper in the future.She pondered for a moment, and a gloom flashed in her eyes: "It doesn't matter, the future is long, we still have the path of being a prince, stay calm first, and slowly find other ways to deal with her."

In the main hall on the other side, tea had just been served. Xiao Yuci seemed to be chatting casually, and seemed to have no intention of asking Shen Jingshan: "I heard that the Prime Minister's daughter is very intelligent. What I saw in the garden just now, she is indeed extraordinary."

Shen Jingshan was stunned. Ever since Shen Qingyuan was obsessed with the prince and always supported Shen Qingrou in everything, he had always thought that his daughter-in-law was naive and stupid. However, after a few things happened today, he had already changed his mind a lot. Hearing this, he smiled and said, "My little girl's temperament has changed a lot recently, and she is very sensible."

Xiao Yuci tapped the table with his fingertips, a faint smile hidden in his eyes. It turned out that the reborn Shen Qingyuan was really different from the silly girl in her previous life who was manipulated by others and died miserably in the fire.
title_en: Chapter 7: The powerful officials looked sideways, and the aunt was worried
